ON_THE_WAY.title: Your order is on its way!
ON_THE_WAY.body: It left {store} and is heading to you. Have your payment ready.

ARRIVING.title: Your courier is almost there
ARRIVING.body: Just a few meters away: step out to get order {code}.

DELIVERED.title: Order {code} delivered
DELIVERED.body: Thanks for ordering with RapiChonta. Enjoy!

_.title: Your order {code} changed
_.body: Tap to see how it's going.

ORDER_OFFERED.title: New order for you
ORDER_OFFERED.body: {store} · tap to see it and take it.

OFFER_WITHDRAWN.title: Order {code} is no longer available
OFFER_WITHDRAWN.body: Another courier took it or it was cancelled.

PREPARATION_TIME_REACHED.title: Is order {code} ready?
PREPARATION_TIME_REACHED.body: The preparation time at {store} is up. Tap to answer.

ADJUSTMENT_REQUESTED.title: Your courier needs a decision
ADJUSTMENT_REQUESTED.body: Something in order {code} is missing or changed price. Reply soon.

INCIDENT_OPENED.title: Update on order {code}
INCIDENT_OPENED.body: We opened a case and will let you know once it's solved.

INCIDENT_RESOLVED.title: Issue resolved
INCIDENT_RESOLVED.body: We closed the case for order {code}.

DELIVERY_PROOF_PENDING.title: Delivery photo missing
DELIVERY_PROOF_PENDING.body: Take the delivery photo for order {code}.
